results.title: Drei Kameradinnen
results.overview: Hani, Kasih and Saya have shared a deep friendship since their youth. Now, after years, the three meet again. But no matter where they are, it becomes clear time and again that everyday racism affects their lives. Nonetheless, their friendship gives them strength. Until one dramatic night shakes everything up.

results.title: 14 Days in Gainesville
results.overview: The fall of 1990 in Gainesville, Florida, heralds the arrival of new head football coach Steve Spurrier, the former Heisman winner who promises to breathe new life into the program. But that enthusiasm is clouded by the darkness of another new arrival: a serial killer who preys on the community, killing five students in quick succession. Over a shocking and unforgettable two-week span, the UF community grapples with unspeakable horror and prepares for a season opener like no other, while clinging to the hope of better days to come.

results.title: Labyrinth of Lost Boys
results.overview: A kid from the country gets lost in the big city looking for love, going on a series of increasingly bizarre dates while a serial killer is on the loose targeting boys his age.

results.title: O Menino Que Carregava Água na Peneira
results.original_title: O Menino Que Carregava Água na Peneira

results.title: Heavenly Bodies
results.overview: After a night of self-destruction and chaos, Enzo records a suicide note as a cry for help. However, despite believing no one is listening, someone will remind him that he is not alone. Even if that someone is from some remote corner of the universe.

results.title: She Likes to Watch
results.overview: Seeking escape from a hollow relationship, Kim is swept into an alluring triad with a married couple. What feels like liberation becomes psychological horror when desire turns possessive and the watcher reveals her power.

results.title: Zé do Caixão: Inferno em Sitges
results.original_title: Zé do Caixão: Inferno em Sitges
results.overview: The love story between José Mojica Marins and the Sitges Film Festival dates back to 1972, when, during its fifth edition, the Catalan Festival screened This Night I'll Possess Your Corpse. It was in 1978 that the Brazilian actor and director attended the Festival for the first time. He would return later in 1997 and 2008, by then firmly established as a key figure in the global horror film scene. This documentary chronicles Marins’ visits to the Festival through images and documents.

results.title: The Secret Between Us
results.overview: A man admired for his integrity watches his perfect life unravel when an unexpected visitor shows up at his front door and forces him to confront the painful consequences of his past betrayal.

results.title: Black Dove
results.overview: When a man leading a double life is murdered during a secret affair, a troubled detective investigating the case must navigate lies, jealousy, and betrayal to uncover the woman who framed the perfect crime.

results.title: Killeidoscope
results.overview: A tale of vengeance with twins Lenny and Lizzie, their abusive mother, the mysterious bird man, a doll named Gino and a serial murderer known as "The Killeidoscope Killer".

results.title: First Time?
results.overview: A boozy Friday night hangout turns sour once a scarring memory takes control.

results.title: Madonna + Graham
results.overview: Graham Norton sits down with the 'Queen of Pop', singer-songwriter, record producer, actress, entrepreneur, charity founder and LGBT rights and gender equality activist Madonna. The pair discuss her lengthy career in which she has achieved 18 multi-platinum albums globally, seven Grammy Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, twenty MTV Video Music Awards and an induction to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

results.title: Love - Love
results.overview: LOVE - LOVE is the story of two brothers : Andy, who suffers from schizophrenia, and Jeff, an actor in search of success and meaning in his life. After the death of their grandmother, Andy is left without a « caretaker ». Refusing to live in a group home, he insists on moving in with their father, Bruce, whom they lost touch with after he fled his responsibilities. The two brothers then set out on a road trip to find their father, a disgraced former professional tennis player, now living in seclusion near the Salton Sea, in the California desert.

results.title: Killer Clown
results.overview: Decades after witnessing her mother’s brutal murder at the hands of the “Killer Clown,” Elizabeth Helmer (Sara Paxton) remains haunted by the crime that shattered her childhood. When she begins investigating the long-unsolved cold case, Elizabeth becomes the target of a terrifying copycat stalker, forcing her to confront painful memories she has spent a lifetime trying to escape. As she searches for answers alongside her father Reed (David Cubitt) and husband Dan (Hamza Haq), Elizabeth uncovers a tangled web of family betrayal and long-buried secrets.  As she closes in on the truth, Elizabeth must separate fact from manipulation and fight to survive before history repeats itself.

results.title: Bad Beast
results.overview: An orphaned girl named Atenea lives in isolation with other children. When adopted by a family, she glimpses a chance at belonging, but her fear of losing this newfound home drives her to extreme measures.

results.title: The City of the Living
results.overview: Luca is twenty-three years old. He lives with an adoptive family who loves him. He moves between the suburbs and the city center with his friends and has a girlfriend with whom he shares a love that is young, yet significant for them both. Luca is searching for his path at an age when everything still feels possible and, at the same time, already lost; in this pursuit, he leads a double life. One night, after a seemingly chance encounter, the trajectory of Luca’s life is shattered, colliding with blind and senseless violence.

results.title: Inheritor
results.overview: On the day of her ascension within her secluded, tree-worshiping cult, Ama, a sheltered young woman, leaps into a treacherous psychedelic ritual that faces her with a choice between her duty to her people and her desire to be with her childhood best friend and lover, Oakley.
